values.description: Your store's root URL (no trailing slash). Change this to your actual domain.
Full API base path. All ecommerce endpoints are relative to this.
Public API key (pk_...). Safe to use for read-only / catalog endpoints. Get from ElevenPOS dashboard → Settings → API Keys.
Secret API key (sk_...). Required for order creation, payments, write operations. Never expose in frontend code.
Bearer token for authenticated customer. Auto-set by the 'Customer Login' and 'Customer Register' requests via test scripts.
Guest cart UUID token. Auto-set by 'Add Item to Cart' request via test script. Send as X-Cart-Token header for guest cart calls.
Reusable product slug for testing product detail, reviews, comments, questions. Replace with a real slug from your store.
Reusable category slug for testing category endpoints. Replace with a real slug from your store.
Order/Sale ID. Auto-set by 'Place Order' request via test script. Used in payment and order detail requests.
Cart item ID. Auto-set by 'Add Item to Cart' request via test script. Used in update/delete cart item requests.
Wishlist item ID. Auto-set by 'Add to Wishlist' request via test script. Used in remove-from-wishlist request.
Return request ID. Auto-set by 'Submit Return Request' via test script. Used in return detail and cancel requests.
Product barcode/variant ID used when adding to cart or placing an order. Replace with a real barcode ID from GET /products/{slug}.
Blog post slug for testing blog detail endpoint. Replace with a real blog slug from your store.
Static page slug for testing the page detail endpoint. Replace with a real page slug from your store.
Language code for translated content (e.g., en, bn). Passed as ?lang= query param.
Test customer email address used in register/login requests.
Test customer password used in register/login requests.
